name: GOLDHAWK
tagline: Golden leads, brass, pads, plucks, bells and basses: 70 presets from 8 synthesis engines.
sub: Hawk leads, brass, pads, bells and eagle cries
gumroad_title: GOLDHAWK - Cinematic Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Leads, Brass, Pads, Bells
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (hawk lead, brass, pad, pluck, FM bells, strings, bass and eagle cry) and 70 factory presets.
about: GOLDHAWK, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.

The 70 factory presets are organized in seven banks of ten: Hawk Leads, Golden Brass, Royal Pads, Falcon Plucks, Sky Bells & Strings, Talon Bass and Eagle Cry & FX. 43 presets load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices; 27 load in Mono mode for single-note leads, basses and cries.
Built for epic and cinematic beats, anthem leads, brass hits, atmospheric pads, bell and pluck motifs, string beds, bass lines and risers.

features.d: Hawk lead, golden brass, royal pad, falcon pluck, FM sky bells, feather strings, talon bass and eagle cry.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from anthem leads to eagle cries.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated attack, decay/release and sustain envelope.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 36 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: GOLDHAWK plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .ghpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
